-- Order Filter; order can be casting an ability, moving, clicking to attack, using scan (radar), glyph etc.
function barebones:OrderFilter(filter_table)
	--PrintTable(filter_table)

	local order = filter_table.order_type
	local units = filter_table.units
	local playerID = filter_table.issuer_player_id_const

	-- Order enums:
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_NONE = 0
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION = 1
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET = 2
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_MOVE = 3
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET = 4
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION = 5
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET = 6
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET_TREE = 7
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET = 8
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE = 9
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_HOLD_POSITION = 10
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_TRAIN_ABILITY = 11
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DROP_ITEM = 12
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_GIVE_ITEM = 13
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PICKUP_ITEM = 14
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PICKUP_RUNE = 15
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PURCHASE_ITEM = 16
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_SELL_ITEM = 17
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DISASSEMBLE_ITEM = 18
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_ITEM = 19
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE_AUTO = 20
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_STOP = 21
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_TAUNT = 22
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_BUYBACK = 23
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_GLYPH = 24
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_EJECT_ITEM_FROM_STASH = 25
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_RUNE = 26
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PING_ABILITY = 27
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_DIRECTION = 28
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PATROL = 29
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_VECTOR_TARGET_POSITION = 30
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_RADAR = 31
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_SET_ITEM_COMBINE_LOCK = 32
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CONTINUE = 33
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_VECTOR_TARGET_CANCELED = 34
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_RIVER_PAINT = 35
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PREGAME_ADJUST_ITEM_ASSIGNMENT = 36
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DROP_ITEM_AT_FOUNTAIN = 37
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_TAKE_ITEM_FROM_NEUTRAL_ITEM_STASH = 39

	-- Example 1: If the order is an ability
	if order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE_AUTO then
		local ability_index = filter_table.entindex_ability
		local ability
		if ability_index then
			ability = EntIndexToHScript(ability_index)
		end
		local caster
		if units and units["0"] then
			caster = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		end
	end

	-- Example 2: If the order is a simple move command
	if order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION and units then
		local destination_x = filter_table.position_x
		local destination_y = filter_table.position_y
		local destination_z = filter_table.position_z
		local unit_with_order
		if units["0"] then
			unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		end

		if unit_with_order and playerID ~= nil and Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[playerID] then
			local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
			local slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
			if not slot and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.GetMainSelectedEntity then
				local mainEnt = PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
				if mainEnt and mainEnt ~= -1 then
					unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(mainEnt)
					slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
				end
			end
			if mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
				unit_with_order = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit_with_order)
			end
			if slot then
				if mgr.debug then
					print("[Shop1Manager] Order MOVE_TO_POSITION slot", slot, "pos", destination_x, destination_y)
				end
				local pos = Vector(destination_x, destination_y, destination_z or 0)
				local synthSlot = mgr:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(slot, pos, 200)
				if synthSlot and mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slot, synthSlot, synthSlot, false) then
					return false
				end
				if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, pos, false) then
					return false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Example 3: If the order is a move/attack target command
	if (order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET) and units then
		local targetIndex = filter_table.entindex_target
		local target = targetIndex and EntIndexToHScript(targetIndex) or nil
		local unit_with_order
		if units["0"] then
			unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		end

		if unit_with_order and target and playerID ~= nil and Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[playerID] then
			local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
			local slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
			if not slot and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.GetMainSelectedEntity then
				local mainEnt = PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
				if mainEnt and mainEnt ~= -1 then
					unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(mainEnt)
					slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
				end
			end
			if mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
				unit_with_order = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit_with_order)
			end
			if slot then
				local targetSlot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(target)
				if targetSlot then
					if mgr.debug then
						print("[Shop1Manager] Order MOVE/ATTACK_TARGET slot", slot, "targetSlot", targetSlot)
					end
					if mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slot, targetSlot, targetSlot, false) then
						return false
					end
					if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, target:GetAbsOrigin(), true) then
						return false
					end
				else
					local synthSlot = mgr:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(slot, target:GetAbsOrigin(), 200)
					if synthSlot and mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slot, synthSlot, synthSlot, false) then
						return false
					end
					if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, target:GetAbsOrigin(), false) then
						return false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Example 3: Disable item sharing for a custom courier that everyone can control
	--[[
	if order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DROP_ITEM or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_GIVE_ITEM then
		local unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		local ability_index = filter_table.entindex_ability
		local ability = EntIndexToHScript(ability_index)

		if unit_with_order:IsCourier() and ability and ability:IsItem() then
			local purchaser = ability:GetPurchaser()
			if purchaser and purchaser:GetPlayerID() ~= playerID then
				CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID), "display_custom_error", { message = "#hud_error_courier_cant_order_item" })
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	]]

	return true
end

local function FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)
	if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local ability_name = damaging_ability and damaging_ability.GetAbilityName and damaging_ability:GetAbilityName() or
	nil
	local mods = attacker:FindAllModifiers()

	if mods then
		for _, mod in pairs(mods) do
			if mod and mod.GetName and mod:GetName() == "modifier_dummy_autocast" then
				if mod.GetProfileForAbilityName then
					local profile = mod:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
					if profile then
						return mod, profile
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local fallback = attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
	if fallback then
		local profile = fallback.GetProfileForAbilityName and fallback:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name) or nil
		return fallback, profile
	end

	return nil, nil
end

-- Damage filter function
function barebones:DamageFilter(keys)
	-- PrintTable(keys)

	local attacker
	local victim
	if keys.entindex_attacker_const and keys.entindex_victim_const then
		attacker = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_attacker_const)
		victim = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_victim_const)
	else
		return false
	end

	local original_attacker = attacker
	local original_victim = victim

	local inflictor = keys.entindex_inflictor_const -- nil if damage is not caused by an ability
	local damaging_ability = inflictor and EntIndexToHScript(inflictor) or nil
	local modifier_autocast, profile = FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)

	if modifier_autocast then
		if profile then
			if profile.hit_label ~= nil then
				victim.hit_label = profile.hit_label
			end

			if profile.base_damage ~= nil then
				victim.base_damage = profile.base_damage
			end

			if profile.damage_scale ~= nil then
				victim.damage_scale = profile.damage_scale
			end

			if profile.pure_percent ~= nil then
				victim.pure_percent = profile.pure_percent
			end

			if profile.lifesteal ~= nil then
				victim.lifesteal = profile.lifesteal
			end
		end

		if modifier_autocast.attacker_override and not modifier_autocast.attacker_override._is_evolving and modifier_autocast.attacker_override:IsRealHero() then
			attacker = modifier_autocast.attacker_override
			victim.last_real_attacker = attacker
		end
	end

	-- Damage types:
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_NONE = 0
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL = 1
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL = 2
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE = 4
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_ALL = 7
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_HP_REMOVAL = 8

	-- Find the ability/item that dealt the dmg, if normal attack or no ability/item it will be nil
	-- damaging_ability resolved above

	if damaging_ability and damaging_ability._is_skill then
		local modifier_cast = original_attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_cast")

		if modifier_cast then
			print("[Filter]", modifier_cast:GetName(), modifier_cast.hit_label, modifier_cast.base_damage)
			if modifier_cast.hit_label then
				victim.hit_label = modifier_cast.hit_label
			end

			if modifier_cast.base_damage then
				victim.base_damage = modifier_cast.base_damage
			end

			if modifier_cast.pure_percent then
				victim.pure_percent = modifier_cast.pure_percent
			end

			if modifier_cast.attacker_override and not modifier_cast.attacker_override._is_evolving and modifier_cast.attacker_override:IsRealHero() then
				attacker = modifier_cast.attacker_override
				victim.last_real_attacker = attacker
			end
		end
	end

	local damage_type             = keys.damagetype_const
	local damage_after_reductions = keys.damage -- keys.damage is damage after reductions without spell amplifications

	-- Lack of entities handling (illusions error fix)
	if attacker:IsNull() or victim:IsNull() then
		return false
	end

	local victim_owner = victim:GetOwner()

	if victim_owner and victim_owner == attacker and damage_type == 0 and damaging_ability == nil then
		return false
	end

	keys.damage = damage_system:ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)

	if victim.transfer_damage then
		local new_victim = victim:GetOwner()
		if new_victim and not new_victim:IsNull() then
			ApplyDamage({
				attacker = attacker,
				victim = new_victim,
				damage = keys.damage,
				damage_type = keys.damagetype_const,
				ability = damaging_ability,
			})

			-- print("[Transfer Damage]", attacker:GetUnitName(), new_victim:GetUnitName(), keys.damage)

			return false
		end
	end

	-- Update the gold bounty of the hero before he dies
	if USE_CUSTOM_HERO_GOLD_BOUNTY then
		if attacker:IsControllableByAnyPlayer() and victim:IsRealHero() and not victim:IsSpiritBearCustom() and not victim:IsTempestDouble() and not victim:IsClone() and damage_after_reductions >= victim:GetHealth() then
			-- Get his killing streak
			local hero_streak = victim:GetStreak()
			-- Get his level
			local hero_level = victim:GetLevel()
			-- Adjust Gold bounty
			local gold_bounty
			if hero_streak > 2 then
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL +
					(hero_streak - 2) * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_STREAK
			else
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL
			end

			victim:SetMinimumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
			victim:SetMaximumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Modifier (buffs, debuffs) filter function
function barebones:ModifierFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local unit_with_modifier
	if keys.entindex_parent_const then
		unit_with_modifier = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_parent_const)
	end
	local modifier_name = keys.name_const
	local modifier_duration = keys.duration
	local caster
	if keys.entindex_caster_const then
		caster = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_caster_const)
	end

	return true
end

-- Experience filter function
function barebones:ExperienceFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)
	local experience = keys.experience
	local playerID = keys.player_id_const
	local reason = keys.reason_const

	-- Reasons:
	-- DOTA_ModifyXP_Unspecified = 0
	-- DOTA_ModifyXP_HeroKill = 1
	-- DOTA_ModifyXP_CreepKill = 2
	-- DOTA_ModifyXP_RoshanKill = 3
	-- DOTA_ModifyXP_TomeOfKnowledge = 4
	-- DOTA_ModifyXP_Outpost = 5
	-- DOTA_ModifyXP_MAX = 6

	return true
end

-- Tracking Projectile (attack and spell projectiles) filter function
function barebones:ProjectileFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local can_be_dodged = keys.dodgeable           -- values: 1 for yes, 0 for no
	local ability_index = keys.entindex_ability_const -- value if not ability: -1
	local source_index = keys.entindex_source_const
	local target_index = keys.entindex_target_const
	local expire_time = keys.expire_time
	local is_an_attack_projectile = keys.is_attack -- values: 1 for yes or 0 for no
	local max_impact_time = keys.max_impact_time
	local projectile_speed = keys.move_speed

	return true
end

-- Bounty Rune Filter, can be used to modify Alchemist's Greevil Greed for example
function barebones:BountyRuneFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local gold_bounty = keys.gold_bounty
	local playerID = keys.player_id_const
	local xp_bounty = keys.xp_bounty -- value: 0

	return true
end

-- Healing Filter, can be used to modify how much hp regen and healing a unit is gaining
-- Triggers every time a unit gains health
function barebones:HealingFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local healing_target_index = keys.entindex_target_const
	local heal_amount = keys.heal -- heal amount of the ability or health restored with hp regen during server tick
	local healer_index = keys.entindex_healer_const
	local healing_ability_index = keys.entindex_inflictor_const

	local healing_target
	if healing_target_index then
		healing_target = EntIndexToHScript(healing_target_index)
	end

	-- Find the source of the heal - the healer
	local healer
	if healer_index then
		healer = EntIndexToHScript(healer_index)
	else
		healer = healing_target -- hp regen
	end

	-- Find healing ability
	-- Abilities that give bonus hp regen don't count as healing abilities!!!
	local healing_ability
	if healing_ability_index then
		healing_ability = EntIndexToHScript(healing_ability_index)
	end
	-- If healing_ability is nil then the 'source' of the heal is unit's hp regen

	if healing_ability then
		-- print("[Healing]", healing_ability, healing_ability._custom_heal, healing_ability:GetAbilityName(), heal_amount, healing_target:GetUnitName(), healing_target:GetPlayerOwnerID())

		if not healing_ability._custom_heal and healing_target:IsRealHero() then
			local modifier_autocast = healer:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")

			if modifier_autocast and modifier_autocast.heal_percent then
				healing_target.heal_percent = modifier_autocast.heal_percent
			end

			heal_amount = damage_system:ProcessHeal(healer, healing_target, keys)
			keys.heal = heal_amount
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Gold filter, can be used to modify how much gold player gains/loses
function barebones:GoldFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local gold = keys.gold
	local playerID = keys.player_id_const
	local reason = keys.reason_const
	local reliable = keys.reliable

	-- Reasons:
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_Unspecified = 0
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_Death = 1
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_Buyback = 2
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_PurchaseConsumable = 3
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_PurchaseItem = 4
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_AbandonedRedistribute = 5
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_SellItem = 6
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_AbilityCost = 7
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_CheatCommand = 8
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_SelectionPenalty = 9
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_GameTick = 10
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_Building = 11
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_HeroKill = 12
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_CreepKill = 13
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_NeutralKill = 14
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_RoshanKill = 15
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_CourierKill = 16
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_BountyRune = 17
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_SharedGold = 18
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_AbilityGold = 19
	-- DOTA_ModifyGold_WardKill = 20

	-- Disable all hero kill gold
	if DISABLE_ALL_GOLD_FROM_HERO_KILLS then
		if reason == DOTA_ModifyGold_HeroKill then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Inventory filter, triggers every time a unit picks up or buys an item, doesn't trigger when you change item's slot inside inventory
function barebones:InventoryFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local unit_with_inventory_index = keys.inventory_parent_entindex_const -- -1 if not defined
	local item_index = keys.item_entindex_const
	local owner_index = keys.item_parent_entindex_const                 -- -1 if not defined
	local item_slot = keys
		.suggested_slot                                                 -- slot in which the item should be put, usually its -1 meaning put in the first free slot

	-- Item slots:
	-- Inventory slots: DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_1 - DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_9
	-- Backpack slots: DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_7 - DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_9
	-- Stash slots: DOTA_STASH_SLOT_1 - DOTA_STASH_SLOT_6
	-- Teleport scroll slot: DOTA_ITEM_TP_SCROLL = 15
	-- Neutral item slot: DOTA_ITEM_NEUTRAL_SLOT = 16
	-- Other constants:
	-- DOTA_ITEM_INVENTORY_SIZE = 9 (DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_1 = 0; DOTA_ITEM_SLOT_9 = 8)
	-- DOTA_ITEM_STASH_MIN = 9 (same as DOTA_STASH_SLOT_1)
	-- DOTA_ITEM_STASH_MAX = 15
	-- DOTA_ITEM_TRANSIENT_ITEM = 17
	-- DOTA_ITEM_TRANSIENT_RECIPE = 18
	-- DOTA_ITEM_MAX = 19
	-- DOTA_ITEM_TRANSIENT_CAST_ITEM = 20

	local unit_with_inventory
	local unit_name
	if unit_with_inventory_index and unit_with_inventory_index ~= -1 then
		unit_with_inventory = EntIndexToHScript(unit_with_inventory_index)
		unit_name = unit_with_inventory:GetUnitName()
	end

	local item
	if item_index then
		item = EntIndexToHScript(item_index)
	end
	local item_name
	if item then
		item_name = item:GetName()
	end

	local owner_of_this_item
	if owner_index and owner_index ~= -1 then
		-- not reliable
		owner_of_this_item = EntIndexToHScript(owner_index)
	elseif item then
		owner_of_this_item = item:GetPurchaser()
	end

	local owner_name
	if owner_of_this_item then
		if owner_of_this_item.GetUnitName then
			-- owner is an NPC
			owner_name = owner_of_this_item:GetUnitName()
		elseif owner_of_this_item.IsPlayer and (owner_of_this_item:IsPlayer() or owner_of_this_item:IsPlayerController()) then
			-- owner is a player
			owner_name = owner_of_this_item:GetName() -- not ideal but you get the idea
		end
	end

	return true
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)

    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then

        end
    end
    return parent.__shop1_visual_dummies
end

    if not parent or parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local list = GetVisualDummies(parent)

                end
                if face_pos and dummy.FaceTowards then

                end

        end
    end

    if profile and profile._resolved_gesture then

local function HasHigherPriorityReady(self, profile, now)
    if not self or not self.projectiles then
        return false
    end
    local my_interval = profile and profile.interval or 0
    for _, other in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if other ~= profile then
            local other_interval = other.interval or 0
            if other_interval > my_interval then
                local ready = not other.next_cast_time or other.next_cast_time <= now
                if ready then
                    if (not other.is_attack and not other.skill) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif (not other.is_attack and other.skill and not other.skill:IsCooldownReady()) then
                        ready = false
                    elseif other.is_attack or other.behavior == "Target" or other.behavior == "Position" then
                        if not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
                            ready = false
                        end
                        if not ready then
                            -- keep ready=false
                        else
                            local origin = self.parent:GetAbsOrigin()
                            local range = self:GetSearchRange(other)
                            local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
                                self.parent:GetTeamNumber(),
                                origin,
                                nil,
                                range,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
                                DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
                                FIND_ANY_ORDER,
                                false
                            )
                            if #enemies == 0 then
                                ready = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if ready then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local hit_label = "projectile"

local function ScheduleAfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not self or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return
    end
    if not self.special_handler or not self.special_handler.AfterCast then
        return
    end

    local handler = self.special_handler
    self.aftercast_timers = self.aftercast_timers or {}
    local id = Timers:CreateTimer(0.2, function()
        if not self or not self.parent or self.parent:IsNull() then
            return nil
        end
        handler:AfterCast(self, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
        return nil
    end)
    table.insert(self.aftercast_timers, id)
end

                name = slot.name,

        "hero_fake_death",
        function(keys) self:OnFakeDeathStateChanged(keys) end,
        nil
    )

    self:StartProjectileTimers()

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end


    -- 【新增】移除监听器
    if self.listener_id then
        StopListeningToGameEvent(self.listener_id)
        self.listener_id = nil
    end

    if self.modifier_sp and self.mod and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        self.parent:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        self.modifier_sp = nil
        self.mod = nil
    end
    if self.attrs_mod and not self.attrs_mod:IsNull() and self.parent and not self.parent:IsNull() then
        self.parent:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.attrs_mod = nil
    end

    if self.timer_handles then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.timer_handles) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.timer_handles = nil
    end
    if self.follow_timer_handles then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.follow_timer_handles) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.follow_timer_handles = nil
    end
    if self.aftercast_timers then
        for _, id in ipairs(self.aftercast_timers) do
            Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
        end
        self.aftercast_timers = nil
    end

    if self.clone_dummies then
        for _, dummy in ipairs(self.clone_dummies) do
            if dummy and not dummy:IsNull() then
                dummy:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.clone_dummies = nil
    end

    if self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.clone_unit:Destroy()
        self.clone_unit = nil
        self.clone_mod = nil
        self.clone_attrs_mod = nil
    end
    if self.clone_pause_timer then
        Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
        self.clone_pause_timer = nil
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:HasCloneProfile()
    if not self.projectiles then return false end
    for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
        if profile.dummy_mode == "clone" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:EnsureCloneUnit()
    if self.clone_unit and not self.clone_unit:IsNull() and self.clone_unit:IsAlive() then
        return self.clone_unit
    end

    local dummy_name = self.parent and self.parent:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
    local clone = CreateUnitByName(
        dummy_name,
        Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
        false,
        self.owner,
        self.owner,
        self.owner:GetTeamNumber()
    )

    if not clone then return nil end

    clone:SetOwner(self.owner)
    clone:SetControllableByPlayer(self.owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    local lvl = self.parent and self.parent:GetLevel() or 1
    if lvl > 1 then
        clone:CreatureLevelUp(lvl - 1)
    end

    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
    clone:AddNewModifier(clone, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
    clone:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
    clone:AddNoDraw()
    clone.__autocast_additional_projectiles = self.additional_projectiles
    clone.__autocast_additional_passives = self.additional_passives
    self.clone_attrs_mod = clone:AddNewModifier(clone, self.ability, "modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs", {
        prevent_death = 1,
    })

    self.clone_mod = clone:AddNewModifier(self.owner, self.ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
        hero_name                    = self.hero_name,
        dummy_level                  = lvl,
        projectile_name              = self.projectile_name,
        projectile_level             = self.projectile_level,
        projectile_interval          = self.projectile_interval,
        projectile_range             = self.projectile_range,
        projectile_base_damage       = self.projectile_base_damage,
        projectile_damage_scale      = self.projectile_damage_scale,
        heal_percent                 = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                 = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode        = "none",

        projectile_sp                = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_level          = self.projectile_sp_level,
        projectile_sp_interval       = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range          = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage    = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_damage_scale   = self.projectile_sp_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_purePercent    = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode     = "none",

        projectile_sp_2              = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_level        = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        projectile_sp_2_interval     = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range        = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage  = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_damage_scale = self.projectile_sp_2_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent  = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode   = "none",

        passive_name                 = self.passive_name,
        passive_level                = self.passive_level,
        passive_sp                   = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level             = self.passive_sp_level,
        passive_sp_2                 = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level           = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                   = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                  = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                 = self.lifesteal_sp,
        prevent_death                = 1,
    })

    self.clone_unit = clone

function modifier_dummy_autocast:ScheduleClonePause(ttl)
    if self.clone_pause_timer then
        Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
    end
    self.clone_pause_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(ttl, function()
        self:DeactivateClone()
    end)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:ActivateClone()
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    self.clone_active = true
    local was_hidden = not self.clone_visible
    DebugClone("[Clone] Activate", GameRules:GetGameTime(), "was_hidden", was_hidden)
    self.clone_unit:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    self.clone_unit:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    if self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_invulnerable")
    end
    if self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.clone_unit:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_no_healthbar")
    end
    self.clone_unit:RemoveNoDraw()
    self.clone_visible = true
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:DeactivateClone()
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit) then
        DebugClone("[DeactivateClone] delayed (busy)", GameRules:GetGameTime())
        if self.clone_pause_timer then
            Timers:RemoveTimer(self.clone_pause_timer)
        end
        self.clone_pause_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
            self:DeactivateClone()
        end)
        return
    end
    self.clone_active = false
    self.clone_visible = false
    if self.clone_mod and not self.clone_mod:IsNull() then
        self.clone_mod.is_paused = true
    end
    if not self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_invulnerable") then
        self.clone_unit:AddNewModifier(self.clone_unit, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    end
    if not self.clone_unit:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.clone_unit:AddNewModifier(self.clone_unit, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end
    self.clone_unit:AddNoDraw()
    if self.clone_unit.SetForceAttackTarget then
        self.clone_unit:SetForceAttackTarget(nil)
    end
    self.clone_unit:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    self.clone_unit:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    self.clone_unit:Stop()
    self.clone_unit:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    self.clone_unit:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    DebugClone("[DeactivateClone]", GameRules:GetGameTime())
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:IsCloneActive()
    if not self.clone_active then
        return false
    end
    if not self.clone_unit or self.clone_unit:IsNull() or not self.clone_unit:IsAlive() then
        self.clone_active = false
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:IsCloneAvailable()
    if not self:IsCloneActive() then
        return false
    end
    return not IsUnitBusy(self.clone_unit)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:OnFakeDeathStateChanged(event_table)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    -- Ensure the event targets this modifier's owner.
    if event_table.entindex ~= self.owner:entindex() then
        return
    end

    local is_dead = event_table.is_dead

    if is_dead == 1 then -- fake death start
        self.is_paused = true

        if self.projectiles then
            for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
                if profile.skill then
                    profile.skill:SetActivated(false)
                end
            end
        end
    elseif is_dead == 0 then -- fake death end
        self.is_paused = false

        if self.projectiles then
            for _, profile in ipairs(self.projectiles) do
                if profile.skill then
                    profile.skill:SetActivated(true)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalInterval(base)
    local s = GetPlayerStats(self.owner)

    if not base or base <= 0 then
        return 0.05
    end

    local pct = 1 + BpToFlat(s.ProjectileCooldown or 0)

    local final = base / pct

    if final < 0.05 then
        final = 0.05
    end

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetHeroProjectileRangeBonus()
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    local pid = self.owner.GetPlayerOwnerID and self.owner:GetPlayerOwnerID() or -1
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return 0
    end
    if not PlayerStats or not PlayerStats.data or not PlayerStats.data[pid] then
        return 0
    end
    local display = PlayerStats.data[pid].Display
    local final = display and display.game_final
    return (final and final.ProjectileRange) or 0
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetFinalCastRange(base)
    local range = base or 0
    local final = range + self:GetHeroProjectileRangeBonus()

    return final
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:GetSearchRange(profile)
    if not profile then
        return 0
    end
    if profile.is_attack then
        return ATTACK_RANGE_OVERRIDE
    end
    return self:GetFinalCastRange(profile.range)
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:UpdateCasterCastRange(profile, final_range, caster)
    if not profile or not profile.skill then
        return
    end
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local attrs_mod = nil
    if caster == self.parent then
        attrs_mod = self.attrs_mod
    elseif caster == self.clone_unit then
        attrs_mod = self.clone_attrs_mod
    end
    if not attrs_mod or attrs_mod:IsNull() then
        attrs_mod = caster:FindModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        if caster == self.parent then
            self.attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        elseif caster == self.clone_unit then
            self.clone_attrs_mod = attrs_mod
        end
    end
    if attrs_mod and not attrs_mod:IsNull() then
        local base_cast_range = GetAbilityCastRange(profile)
        autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyCastRangeOverride(attrs_mod, final_range, base_cast_range, CAST_RANGE_PADDING)
    end
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:FirePseudoTrackingProjectile(profile, target)
    if not target or target:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.owner or self.owner:IsNull() then return end
    if not self.ability or self.ability:IsNull() then return end

    -- Keep dummy on the hero.
    self.parent:SetAbsOrigin(self.owner:GetAbsOrigin())
    self.parent:FaceTowards(target:GetAbsOrigin())

    local proj_speed = 900

    local info = {
        Target     = target,
        Source     = self.owner,
        Ability    = self.ability,
        EffectName = self.ability:GetAbilityKeyValues().ProjectileModel,
        iMoveSpeed = proj_speed,
        bDodgeable = true,
        bIsAttack  = false,
        ExtraData  = {
            owner_entindex = self.owner:entindex(),
            dummy_entindex = self.parent:entindex(),
            base_damage    = profile.base_damage,
            damage_scale   = profile.damage_scale,
            hit_label      = profile.hit_label,
            proj_speed     = proj_speed,

            spawn_time     = GameRules:GetGameTime(),
            max_time       = 2,
        }
    }

    local proj_id = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
    info.ExtraData.projectile_id = proj_id
end

function modifier_dummy_autocast:InitProjectileProfile(params)
    if not params then return end
    local name = params.name
    if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then return end
    if not params.interval or params.interval <= 0 then return end

    local is_attack = (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack")
    local profile = {
        projectile_name = name,

                effects = effect_overrides.replace
            end
            if effect_overrides.additional and #effect_overrides.additional > 0 then
                additional_effects = additional_effects or {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(effect_overrides.additional) do
                    table.insert(additional_effects, entry)
                end
            end
        end
        config.effects = effects
        config.additional_effects = additional_effects
        for key, value in pairs(config) do
            self[key] = value
        end

        self:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    end)
end

local function ApplyHeroPassive(parent, name, level, label)
    if not name or not parent then
        return
    end

    local ability = parent:AddAbility(name)
    if not ability then
        return
    end

    if label then
        print(label, ability:GetAbilityName())
    end

    if level and tonumber(level) > 0 then
        ability:SetLevel(tonumber(level))
    else
        ability:SetLevel(1)
    end

    autocast_common.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, true)
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:GetFormationCount()
    local lvl = tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1
    if lvl == 2 then
        return 2
    end
    if lvl == 3 then
        return 3
    end
    return 1
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureVisualDummies(count)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self.visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies or {}
    local need = math.max(0, (count or 1) - 1)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)

    if need <= 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            if v and not v:IsNull() then
                v:Destroy()
            end
        end
        self.visual_dummies = {}
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = nil
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        return
    end

    while #self.visual_dummies > need do
        local v = table.remove(self.visual_dummies)
        if v and not v:IsNull() then
            v:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
    local owner = self.dummy:GetOwner() or self.dummy
    local name = self.dummy:GetUnitName()

    while #self.visual_dummies < need do
        local v = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            self.dummy:GetAbsOrigin(),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if v then
            v:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                v:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            
            if v.SetAttackCapability then
                v:SetAttackCapability(DOTA_UNIT_CAP_NO_ATTACK)
            end
            if v.SetAttackAcquisitionRange then
                v:SetAttackAcquisitionRange(0)
            end

            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not v:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                v:AddNewModifier(v, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end
            SetUnselectable(v, true)
            v:AddNoDraw()
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s offset=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(offset)))
            local selectable = (v.IsUnselectable and not v:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][visual] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(v:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            table.insert(self.visual_dummies, v)
        else
            break
        end
    end

    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
    self.dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = self.visual_dummies
    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        self.dummy_sp.__shop1_visual_dummies = self.visual_dummies
        self.dummy_sp.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = self.visual_dummies
        self.dummy_sp.__shop1_visual_main = self.dummy
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_radius)
    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    if count <= 1 then
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
            self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        end
        return
    end

    if not self.selection_proxy or self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        local owner = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetOwner() or nil
        local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(self.dummy)
        local name = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetUnitName() or "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy"
        local proxy = CreateUnitByName(
            name,
            center_pos or Vector(0, 0, 0),
            false,
            owner,
            owner,
            team
        )
        if proxy then
            proxy:SetOwner(owner)
            if owner and owner.GetPlayerOwnerID then
                proxy:SetControllableByPlayer(owner:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
            end
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
            proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
            if not proxy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
                proxy:AddNewModifier(proxy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
            end

            proxy:AddNoDraw()

            SetUnselectable(proxy, false)
            local selectable = (proxy.IsUnselectable and not proxy:IsUnselectable()) or false
            -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][proxy] ent=%s selectable=%s",
            --     tostring(proxy:GetEntityIndex()),
            --     tostring(selectable)))
            proxy.__shop1_proxy_dummy = self.dummy and self.dummy:GetEntityIndex() or nil
            self.selection_proxy = proxy
            if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
                self.dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = proxy:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end

    if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
        if center_pos then
            self.selection_proxy:SetAbsOrigin(center_pos)
        end
        if max_radius and self.selection_proxy.SetHullRadius then
            self.selection_proxy:SetHullRadius(max_radius)
        end
        if GoodForward then
            self.selection_proxy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)
        end
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:UpdateFormationAtPos(center_pos)
    if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    if not center_pos then
        return nil
    end

    local count = self:GetFormationCount()
    self:EnsureVisualDummies(count)

    local forward = GoodForward or self.dummy:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0)
    local right = GetRightVector(forward)
    local base_r = GetHullRadiusSafe(self.dummy)
    local offset = GetFormationOffset(self.dummy)
    local r = base_r + offset
    local s = r * 2
    local h = s * 0.8660254

    local positions = {}
    if count == 1 then
        positions[1] = center_pos
    elseif count == 2 then
        positions[1] = center_pos - right * r
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * r
    elseif count == 3 then
        positions[1] = center_pos + forward * (2 * h / 3)
        positions[2] = center_pos + right * (-s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
        positions[3] = center_pos + right * (s / 2) + forward * (-h / 3)
    end

    if positions[1] then
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(positions[1])
    end
    if self.visual_dummies then
        for i, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
            local pos = positions[i + 1]
            if v and not v:IsNull() and pos then
                v:SetAbsOrigin(pos)
                if v.SetForwardVector then
                    v:SetForwardVector(forward)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if count > 1 then
        local max_dist = 0
        for _, pos in ipairs(positions) do
            local dist = (pos - center_pos):Length2D()
            if dist > max_dist then
                max_dist = dist
            end
        end
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(center_pos, max_dist + r)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, true)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, true)
        end
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        self:DeleteWorldPanel()
    else
        self:EnsureSelectionProxy(nil, nil)
        SetUnselectable(self.dummy, false)
        if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
            SetUnselectable(self.dummy_sp, false)
        end
        local main_selectable = (self.dummy.IsUnselectable and not self.dummy:IsUnselectable()) or false
        -- print(string.format("[Shop1Dummy][main] ent=%s selectable=%s",
        --     tostring(self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()),
        --     tostring(main_selectable)))
        self:DeleteWorldPanel()
    end
    local main_pos = positions[1]
    local should_reveal = main_pos and main_pos:Length2D() < 9000
    local panel_entity = (count > 1) and self.selection_proxy or self.dummy
    self:ScheduleReveal(panel_entity, should_reveal)
    return main_pos
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:CreateDummy(parent, ability)
    local dummy_name = "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. self.lvl

    local team = GetSafeTeamNumber(parent)
    self.is_revealed = false
    local pooled = TakeDummyFromPool(dummy_name)
    if pooled then
        self.dummy = pooled
        self.dummy.__autocast_destroying = nil
        self.dummy:AddNoDraw()
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_invulnerable")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_no_healthbar")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
        self.dummy:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs")
        self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
        self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
        self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(Vector(10000, 10000, 0))
    else
        self.dummy = CreateUnitByName(
            dummy_name,
            Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
            false,
            parent,
            parent,
            team
        )
        if self.dummy then
            self.dummy:AddNoDraw()
        end
    end

    if not self.dummy then
        return
    end

    self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
    self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
    self.dummy:SetIdleAcquire(false)
    self.dummy:SetAcquisitionRange(0)
    local dummy_level = Shop1Managers:GetDummyLevel(tonumber(self.lvl)) or 1

    if dummy_level > 1 then
        dummy_level = dummy_level - 1
        self.dummy:CreatureLevelUp(dummy_level)
    end

    if self.pid and self.slot then
        Shop1Managers[self.pid].Slots[self.slot].Dummy = self.dummy:GetEntityIndex()
        local pos = Shop1Managers[self.pid] and Shop1Managers[self.pid]:GetGoodPointPos(self.slot)
        if not pos then
            local point = EntIndexToHScript(self.slot)
            if point then
                pos = point:GetOrigin()
            end
        end
        if pos then
            self.dummy:SetOrigin(pos)
        end
    end

    self.dummy:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

    self:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(self.dummy)

    -- self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）
    if not self.dummy:HasModifier("modifier_no_healthbar") then
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_no_healthbar", {})
    end

    -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
    if self.dummy then
        -- Avoid passing tables through modifier KV (causes HSCRIPT argument unsupported).
        self.dummy.__autocast_additional_projectiles = self.extra_projectiles
        self.dummy.__autocast_additional_passives = self.additional_passives
        self.dummy.__autocast_effects = self.effects
        self.dummy.__autocast_additional_effects = self.additional_effects
    end
    local modifier_kv = {
        hero_name                   = self.hero_name,
        dummy_level                 = self.dummy:GetLevel(),
        projectile_name             = self.projectile_name,
        projectile_level            = self.projectile_level,
        projectile_interval         = self.projectile_interval,
        projectile_range            = self.projectile_range,
        projectile_base_damage      = self.projectile_base_damage,
        projectile_damage_scale     = self.projectile_damage_scale,
        heal_percent                = self.heal_percent,
        pure_percent                = self.pure_percent,
        projectile_dummy_mode       = self.projectile_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp               = self.projectile_sp,
        projectile_sp_level         = self.projectile_sp_level,
        projectile_sp_interval      = self.projectile_sp_interval,
        projectile_sp_range         = self.projectile_sp_range,
        projectile_sp_base_damage   = self.projectile_sp_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_damage_scale  = self.projectile_sp_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_purePercent   = self.projectile_sp_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_dummy_mode    = self.projectile_sp_dummy_mode,

        projectile_sp_2             = self.projectile_sp_2,
        projectile_sp_2_level       = self.projectile_sp_2_level,
        projectile_sp_2_interval    = self.projectile_sp_2_interval,
        projectile_sp_2_range       = self.projectile_sp_2_range,
        projectile_sp_2_base_damage = self.projectile_sp_2_base_damage,
        projectile_sp_2_damage_scale    = self.projectile_sp_2_damage_scale,
        projectile_sp_2_purePercent = self.projectile_sp_2_purePercent,
        projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode  = self.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode,

        passive_name                = self.passive_name,
        passive_level               = self.passive_level,

        passive_sp                  = self.passive_sp,
        passive_sp_level            = self.passive_sp_level,

        passive_sp_2                = self.passive_sp_2,
        passive_sp_2_level          = self.passive_sp_2_level,

        ability_sp                  = self.ability_sp,
        modifier_sp                 = self.modifier_sp,
        lifesteal_sp                = self.lifesteal_sp,
    }

    self.dummy:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", modifier_kv)

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())
    self:CancelRevealTimer()
    self:DeleteWorldPanel()

    local hero = self:GetParent()

    if self.hero_passive then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.hero_passive_sp_2 then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveAbility(self.hero_passive_sp_2)
        end
    end

    if self.modifier_sp then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName(self.modifier_sp)
        end
    end

    if self.skill_listener then
        if hero then
            hero:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_item_cast_listener")
        end
    end

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        local dummy = self.dummy
        self.dummy = nil
        if self.visual_dummies then
            for _, v in ipairs(self.visual_dummies) do
                if v and not v:IsNull() then
                    v:Destroy()
                end
            end
            self.visual_dummies = nil
        end
        dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies = nil
        dummy.__shop1_visual_dummies_last = nil
        if self.selection_proxy and not self.selection_proxy:IsNull() then
            self.selection_proxy:Destroy()
        end
        self.selection_proxy = nil
        dummy.__shop1_selection_proxy = nil
        PrepareDummyForPool(dummy)
        ReturnDummyToPool("npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy" .. "_" .. self.hero_name .. "_" .. tostring(self.lvl), dummy)
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    if self.dummy_sp and not self.dummy_sp:IsNull() then
        local dummy_sp = self.dummy_sp
        self.dummy_sp = nil
        PrepareDummyForPool(dummy_sp)
        ReturnDummyToPool("npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy_sp", dummy_sp)
    end
end

function modifier_item_autocast_controller:EnsureStarWorldPanelForEntity(entity)
    if not entity or entity:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    if not WorldPanels then
        return
    end

    if self.worldPanel then
        self.worldPanel:Delete()
        self.worldPanel = nil
    end

    local level = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(self.custom_level) or tonumber(self.lvl) or 1, 6))
    local stars = string.rep("★", level)

    self.worldPanel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
        layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/shop1_dummy_level.xml",
        entity = entity,
        entityHeight = 100,
        horizontalAlign = "center",
        verticalAlign = "bottom",
        offsetY = -25,
        data = {
            stars = stars,
            level = level,
        },
    })

    if not self.worldPanel then
        print("[WorldPanel Error] CreateWorldPanelForAll returned nil")
    end
end

local common = require("projectiles.autocast_common")

local M = {}

GestureDefaults = {
            invoker_chaos_meteor = ACT_DOTA_CAST_CHAOS_METEOR,
            invoker_deafening_blast = ACT_DOTA_CAST_DEAFENING_BLAST,
            invoker_ice_wall = ACT_DOTA_CAST_ICE_WALL,
        }

local function SplitByPipe(raw)
    local list = {}
    if raw == nil then
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed ~= "" then
            table.insert(list, trimmed)
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function NormalizeList(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return {}
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        local list = {}
        local numeric_keys = {}
        local has_numeric = false
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            if type(k) == "number" then
                has_numeric = true
                table.insert(numeric_keys, k)
            else
                table.insert(list, k)
                if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
                    table.insert(list, v)
                end
            end
        end
        if has_numeric then
            table.sort(numeric_keys)
            for _, k in ipairs(numeric_keys) do
                local v = raw[k]
                if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
                    table.insert(list, v)
                end
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return {}
    end
    local pipe = SplitByPipe(s)
    if #pipe > 0 then
        return pipe
    end
    return { raw }
end

local function GetListValueAt(raw, index)
    local list = NormalizeList(raw)
    if #list == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local idx = math.min(index or 1, #list)
    return list[idx]
end

local function ResolveLevelValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level or 1, #nums)]
    end
    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level or 1, #strs)]
    end
    return s
end

local function ReadEffectList(raw_kv, level, prefix)
    if not raw_kv then
        return {}
    end
    local name_key = prefix .. "Name"
    local names = NormalizeList(raw_kv[name_key])
    if #names == 0 then
        return {}
    end

    local list = {}
    for i, raw_name in ipairs(names) do
        local name = common.NormalizeName(raw_name)
        if name then
            table.insert(list, {
                name = name,
                interval = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "Interval"], i), level),
                range = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "Range"], i), level),
                base_damage = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "BaseDamage"], i), level),
                damage_scale = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "DamageScale"], i), level),
                heal_percent = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "HealPercent"], i), level),
                pure_percent = ResolveLevelValue(GetListValueAt(raw_kv[prefix .. "PurePercent"], i), level),
            })
        end
    end

    return list
end

function M.ReadEffects(raw_kv, level, prefix)
    return ReadEffectList(raw_kv, level, prefix or "Effect")
end

local function ReadProjectileBlock(raw, prefix)
    local name = common.NormalizeName(raw[prefix])
    if not name then
        return nil
    end

    local cfg = { name = name }

    if raw[prefix .. "Level"] then
        cfg.level = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Level"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "Interval"] then
        cfg.interval = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Interval"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "Range"] then
        cfg.range = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Range"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "BaseDamage"] then
        cfg.base_damage = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "BaseDamage"])
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "DamageScale"] then
        cfg.damage_scale = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "DamageScale"]))
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"] and raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"] ~= "" then
        cfg.pure_percent = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"]))
    end
    if raw[prefix .. "DummyMode"] then
        cfg.dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw[prefix .. "DummyMode"])
    end

    return cfg
end

local function ReadSPSlot(raw, idx)
    local suffix = (idx == 1) and "" or tostring(idx)
    local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
    local slot = ReadProjectileBlock(raw, prefix)
    if not slot then
        return nil
    end

    if slot.interval == nil then
        slot.interval = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Interval"])
    end
    if slot.range == nil then
        slot.range = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "Range"])
    end
    if slot.base_damage == nil then
        slot.base_damage = common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "BaseDamage"])
    end
    if slot.damage_scale == nil then
        slot.damage_scale = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "DamageScale"]))
    end
    if slot.pure_percent == nil and raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"] then
        slot.pure_percent = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw[prefix .. "PurePercent"]))
    end
    if slot.dummy_mode == nil then
        slot.dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw[prefix .. "DummyMode"])
    end

    return slot
end

function M.Read(raw_kv)
    local cfg = {}
    if not raw_kv then
        return cfg
    end

    cfg.hero_name = raw_kv.HeroName

    cfg.projectile_name = raw_kv.ProjectileName
    if raw_kv.ProjectileLevel then
        cfg.projectile_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.ProjectileLevel)
    end

    local values = raw_kv.AbilityValues or {}
    cfg.projectile_interval = common.ToNumber(values.ProjectileInterval)
    cfg.projectile_range = common.ToNumber(values.ProjectileRange)
    cfg.projectile_base_damage = common.ToNumber(values.ProjectileBaseDamage)
    cfg.projectile_damage_scale = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(values.ProjectileDamageScale))

    if not cfg.projectile_interval or cfg.projectile_interval <= 0 then
        cfg.projectile_interval = 2.0
    end
    if not cfg.projectile_range or cfg.projectile_range <= 0 then
        cfg.projectile_range = 800
    end

    if raw_kv.HealPercent and raw_kv.HealPercent ~= "" then
        cfg.heal_percent = BpToRatio(raw_kv.HealPercent)
    end
    if raw_kv.PurePercent and raw_kv.PurePercent ~= "" then
        cfg.pure_percent = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PurePercent))
    end

    local function apply_slot_defaults(slot)
        if not slot then
            return nil
        end
        if slot.interval == nil then
            slot.interval = 2
        end
        if slot.range == nil then
            slot.range = 800
        end
        if slot.base_damage == nil then
            slot.base_damage = 0
        end
        if slot.damage_scale == nil then
            slot.damage_scale = 1
        end
        return slot
    end

    cfg.extra_projectiles = {}

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local slot = ReadSPSlot(raw_kv, i)
        if slot then
            slot = apply_slot_defaults(slot)
            if i == 1 then
                cfg.projectile_sp = slot.name
                cfg.projectile_sp_level = slot.level
                cfg.projectile_sp_interval = slot.interval
                cfg.projectile_sp_range = slot.range
                cfg.projectile_sp_base_damage = slot.base_damage
                cfg.projectile_sp_damage_scale = slot.damage_scale
                cfg.projectile_sp_purePercent = slot.pure_percent
                cfg.projectile_sp_dummy_mode = slot.dummy_mode
            elseif i == 2 then
                cfg.projectile_sp_2 = slot.name
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_level = slot.level
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_interval = slot.interval
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_range = slot.range
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_base_damage = slot.base_damage
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_damage_scale = slot.damage_scale
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_purePercent = slot.pure_percent
                cfg.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode = slot.dummy_mode
            else
                table.insert(cfg.extra_projectiles, {
                    name = slot.name,
                    level = slot.level,
                    interval = slot.interval,
                    range = slot.range,
                    base_damage = slot.base_damage,
                    damage_scale = slot.damage_scale,
                    pure_percent = slot.pure_percent,
                    dummy_mode = slot.dummy_mode,
                })
            end
        end
    end

    cfg.passive_name = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.PassiveName)
    cfg.passive_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PassiveLevel)
    cfg.passive_sp = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.PassiveSP)
    cfg.passive_sp_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PassiveSPLevel)
    cfg.passive_sp_2 = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.PassiveSP2)
    cfg.passive_sp_2_level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv.PassiveSP2Level)
    cfg.additional_passives = {}
    for i = 3, 6 do
        local suffix = tostring(i)
        local name = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv["PassiveSP" .. suffix])
        if name and name ~= "" and name ~= "none" then
            table.insert(cfg.additional_passives, {
                name = name,
                level = common.ToNumber(raw_kv["PassiveSP" .. suffix .. "Level"]),
            })
        end
    end

    cfg.projectile_dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ProjectileDummyMode)
    cfg.projectile_sp_dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ProjectileSPDummyMode)
    cfg.projectile_sp_2_dummy_mode = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ProjectileSP2DummyMode)

    cfg.ability_sp = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.AbilitySP)
    cfg.modifier_sp = common.NormalizeName(raw_kv.ModifierSP)

    if raw_kv.LifestealSP and common.ToNumber(raw_kv.LifestealSP) and common.ToNumber(raw_kv.LifestealSP) > 0 then
        cfg.lifesteal_sp = BpToRatio(common.ToNumber(raw_kv.LifestealSP))
    end

    return cfg
end

return M

spawn_manager = class({})

SpawnManagers = {}
require("spawn_wall_manager")

function InitAllPlayerSpawnManagers()
    local total = PlayerResource:GetPlayerCount()

    for pid = 0, total - 1 do
        if PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
            CreatePlayerSpawnManager(pid)
            --print("SpawnManager Created For Player:", pid)
        end
    end
end

function CreatePlayerSpawnManager(pid)
    local mgr = spawn_manager()
    mgr.pid = pid
    mgr:Start()
    mgr.buff_provider = {}
    SpawnManagers[pid] = mgr
    return mgr
end

-- 配置文件
WavesKV        = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/monster_waves.txt") or {}
ChallengeKV    = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/challenge_waves.txt") or {}
PermanentKVRaw = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/permanent_waves.txt") or {}
DifficultyKV   = LoadKeyValues("scripts/npc/monsters/difficulty.txt") or {}


--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 工具
--------------------------------------------------------------------、

local function CollectSpawnPoints(spawnPointsKV)
    local points = {}
    for _, name in pairs(spawnPointsKV or {}) do
        local ent = Entities:FindByName(nil, name)
        if ent then
            table.insert(points, ent)
        end
    end
    return points
end

local function BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, data)
    -- 1. 显式顺序（最高优先级）
    local orderStr = data and data["MonsterOrder"]
    if orderStr and tostring(orderStr) ~= "" then
        local arr = ParseStringArray(orderStr)
        local ordered = {}
        local seen = {}

        for _, name in ipairs(arr) do
            if monstersKV[name] ~= nil and not seen[name] then
                seen[name] = true
                table.insert(ordered, name)
            end
        end

        -- 防止漏写：Monsters 里有但 MonsterOrder 没写的，补到最后
        for name, _ in pairs(monstersKV or {}) do
            if not seen[name] then
                table.insert(ordered, name)
            end
        end

        return ordered
    end

    -- 2. 兜底：字典序（保证确定性）
    local ordered = {}
    for name, _ in pairs(monstersKV or {}) do
        table.insert(ordered, name)
    end
    table.sort(ordered)
    return ordered
end

local function BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)
    local result = {}
    spawnPointsKV = spawnPointsKV or {}

    for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates or {}) do
        local val = spawnPointsKV[template]
        if val then
            local arr = ParseStringArray(val)
            result[template] = CollectSpawnPoints(arr)
        else
            result[template] = {}
        end
    end

    return result
end

local BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE = 500
local BOSS_PANEL_UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.1

local BossHealthPanels = {}
local BossHealthPanelTicker = nil
local NET_TABLE_NAME = "boss_health"

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Build payload (plain table only)
----------------------------------------------------------------
local function BuildBossPanelPayload(entry)
    if not entry or not entry.unit then
        return nil
    end

    local unit = entry.unit
    if unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end

    local maxHealth = math.max(unit:GetMaxHealth(), 1)
    local currentHealth = math.max(0, math.min(unit:GetHealth(), maxHealth))
    local segmentValue = entry.segment_value or BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE
    local totalSegments = math.max(1, math.ceil(maxHealth / segmentValue))

    entry.max_segments = totalSegments

    print("[Boss]", maxHealth, currentHealth, segmentValue, totalSegments)

    return {
        segments = totalSegments,
        segment_value = segmentValue,
        multiplier = totalSegments,
        current_health = currentHealth,
        max_health = maxHealth,
    }
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Cleanup

local function CleanupBossPanel(entid)
    local entry = BossHealthPanels[entid]
    if not entry then
        return
    end

    if entry.panel then
        entry.panel:Delete()
    end

    -- 清空 NetTable，避免残留
    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue(NET_TABLE_NAME, tostring(entid), nil)

    BossHealthPanels[entid] = nil
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- Ticker (only NetTable updates)
----------------------------------------------------------------
local function EnsureBossPanelTicker()
    if BossHealthPanelTicker then
        return
    end

    BossHealthPanelTicker = Timers:CreateTimer(function()
        for entid, entry in pairs(BossHealthPanels) do
            local unit = entry.unit
            if not unit or unit:IsNull() or not unit:IsAlive() then
                CleanupBossPanel(entid)
            else
                local payload = BuildBossPanelPayload(entry)
                if payload then
                    CustomNetTables:SetTableValue(
                        NET_TABLE_NAME,
                        tostring(entid),
                        payload
                    )
                end
            end
        end
        return BOSS_PANEL_UPDATE_INTERVAL
    end)
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
function RegisterBossHealthPanel(unit, segmentValue)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    if not WorldPanels then
        return
    end

    local entid = unit:GetEntityIndex()
    if BossHealthPanels[entid] then
        return
    end

    local panel = WorldPanels:CreateWorldPanelForAll({
        layout = "file://{resources}/layout/custom_game/worldpanels/boss_health.xml",
        entity = unit,
        entityHeight = 400,
        horizontalAlign = "center",
        verticalAlign = "top",
        offsetY = 0,

        data = {
            entity_index = entid,
            segment_value = segmentValue or BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE, -- 可选：初始化也能用
        },
    })

    if not panel then
        return
    end

    BossHealthPanels[entid] = {
        unit = unit,
        panel = panel,
        segment_value = segmentValue or BOSS_HEALTH_SEGMENT_VALUE,
        max_segments = 1,
    }

    -- 首次推送一次数据
    local payload = BuildBossPanelPayload(BossHealthPanels[entid])
    if payload then
        CustomNetTables:SetTableValue(
            NET_TABLE_NAME,
            tostring(entid),
            payload
        )
    end

    EnsureBossPanelTicker()
end

function spawn_manager:GetRunAliveCount(rid)
    local run = self.runs[rid]
    if not run then return 0 end

    local alive = 0
    for _, u in ipairs(run.monsters) do
        if u and IsValidEntity(u) and u:IsAlive() then
            alive = alive + 1
        end
    end
    return alive
end

function spawn_manager:CreateManagedTimer(delay, callback)
    local id
    id = Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
        return callback()
    end)
    table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
    return id
end

function spawn_manager:CalcNextWaveAndBoss(fromIndex, startTime)
    local acc_time  = startTime or GameRules:GetGameTime()
    local next_wave = 0
    local next_boss = 0

    -- 从 fromIndex 之后的那一波开始（0 表示从第 1 波开始看）
    for i = fromIndex, 999 do
        local w = WavesKV[tostring(i)]
        if not w then break end

        local pre = tonumber(w["PreDelay"]) or 0
        local dur = tonumber(w["Duration"]) or 0
        local isB = (tostring(w["IsBossWave"] or "0") == "1")

        acc_time = acc_time + pre

        if (not isB) and next_wave == 0 then
            next_wave = acc_time
        end

        if isB and next_boss == 0 then
            next_boss = acc_time
        end

        -- 如果找到了普通波生成点，且已经确定了下一个 Boss 点（或之后没 Boss），则退出
        if next_wave > 0 and (next_boss > 0 or i > fromIndex + 5) then
            break
        end

        -- 累加持续时间，用于计算再下一波的起点
        acc_time = acc_time + dur
    end

    return next_wave, next_boss
end

function spawn_manager:InitChallenges()
    self.challenge_state = {}
    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()

    for id, data in pairs(ChallengeKV) do
        local cd = tonumber(data["Cooldown"]) or 30
        local initUnlock = tonumber(data["InitialUnlock"]) or 0
        local name = data["Name"] or "Unknown Challenge"

        local idx = tonumber(id) or id -- 统一内部索引

        local firstReady = now + initUnlock

        self.challenge_state[idx] = {
            count         = 0,
            nextAvailable = firstReady,
        }

        -- 初始化 UI
        CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("challenge_waves", tostring(id), {
            cooldown = cd,
            next_cd  = firstReady,
            count    = 0,
            name     = name,
        })
    end

    --print("[Challenge] All challenges initialized & sent to UI.")
end

function spawn_manager:StopAll()
    -- print("[spawn_manager] StopAll")

    -- 停所有 timer
    for _, id in ipairs(self.timer_handles) do
        Timers:RemoveTimer(id)
    end
    self.timer_handles = {}

    -- 停所有 wave_active
    self.wave_active = false

    -- 停永久刷怪逻辑
    self.permanent_start_time = nil

    -- 停所有怪的AI（modifier_simple_chase_ai）

    GameRules.clearing_monsters = true

    for k, v in pairs(self.active_monsters) do
        local u = EntIndexToHScript(k)
        if IsValidEntity(u) then
            u:Destroy()
        end

        self.active_monsters[k] = nil
    end

    GameRules.clearing_monsters = false
end

function spawn_manager:ResetAI()
    for key, value in pairs(self.active_monsters) do
        if value then
            value:ResetAI()
        end
    end
end

function spawn_manager:Start()
    self:Init()

    local wave1 = WavesKV["1"]
    if not wave1 then return end

    local pre                          = tonumber(wave1["PreDelay"]) or 0

    self.wave_state.game_start_time    = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    self.wave_state.pre_delay_end_time = GameRules:GetGameTime() + pre

    self.wave_state.current_wave       = 0
    self.wave_state.next_wave_time     = 0
    self.wave_state.next_boss_time     = 0

    self:SyncWaveState()

    self:CreateManagedTimer(pre, function()
        self.current_wave_index = 0
        self:StartNextWave(true)
    end)
end

function spawn_manager:CreateRun(type, id, total)
    self.run_seq = self.run_seq + 1
    local rid = self.run_seq

    self.runs[rid] = {
        type           = type, -- "wave" / "boss" / "challenge"
        id             = id,
        alive          = total,
        monsters       = {},

        time_completed = false,

    return rid
